Adventurer's Hat.Flavor Text: You have a sweet hat that's been with you through thick and thin!
Adventurer's Hat.Description: Counts as a separate inventory item on expeditions. When encountering an Item Lost event, and this hat is targeted, you lose 1 morale and this trait.

Asocial.Flavor Text: You lose morale if you share a room with others over cycle change. Also enables bringing a pet aboard.

Bionic Arm.Flavor Text: One arm has been replaced with a state-of-the-art bionic.
Bionic Arm.Description: While your bionic arm is equipped, you have +1 to all combat strength against non-crew and can carry more. However, without it, all actions cost 1 more AP. If it breaks, fixing it is a high priority.

Capricious.Flavor Text: You're a pathological troublemaker. Resisting the urge will tax your sanity.
Capricious.Description: Every day, you get a random objective which is usually fulfilled by performing a certain action. If you do not complete this objective by the end of the day, you lose 3 morale.

Chronic Illness.Flavor Text: Your health is deteriorating, but this gives you the will to push on.
Chronic Illness.Description: You have a small chance of taking 2 HP damage every time you spend AP. You also have a small chance of reducing morale damage by 1.

Disabled.Flavor Text: Moving is more costly for you, but others can help you.
Disabled.Description: -2 MP on AP/MP conversions. If you leave the room while someone else is in the room, you move without spending MP.

First Timer.Flavor Text: You have never done it. Your first time will max out your morale.
First Timer.Description: Doing the thing with another player will set your morale to its maximum value, then remove this trait.

Germaphobe.Flavor Text: You lose morale if you are dirty on cycle change.

Hyperactive.Flavor Text: You don't gain AP from beds, but you gain +1 MP per cycle.

Illiterate.Description: Terminal screens appear as gibberish to you. +1 AP cost for actions at any terminal. You cannot read physical items either (books, post-its, etc) but you can still use Mage Books (as the knowledge is directly implanted). Fortunately, your trackie has text-to-speech functionality, so things like the map and Astropad are unaffected.

Immunized.Flavor Text: You are immune to becoming Mush.
Immunized.Description: You cannot be infected with spores, thus you are always human and can be trusted - but this also makes you a bigger target for the Mush...

Minor.Flavor Text: You're not quite an adult. Life is simpler, but also more dangerous.
Minor.Description:
This has myriad effects:
- Slightly increased chances of accidents and getting dirty.
- Illnesses and injuries have slightly worse effects.
- When you die, other crewmembers lose 2 morale instead of 1.
- You cannot flirt or DTT, but you can use and benefit from the `befriend` and `play` commands.
- You start the game with a Teddy Bear. The Teddy Bear works drastically more often for you.

Monocular.Flavor Text: You only have one functional eye. This makes certain tasks more difficult, but your other senses have heightened to compensate.
Monocular.Description: Accuracy for shoot actions is reduced, and accident chance is slightly increased. However, you have a better chance to dodge attacks, and a small chance of negating physical injuries entirely.

Pacifist.Flavor Text: Aggressive actions near you are more costly.
Pacifist.Description: Increases the AP cost of aggressive actions in the same room as you by 2.

Sixth Sense.Flavor Text: You receive visions whenever someone does something secret.
Sixth Sense.Description: Anytime a secret or covert action is performed by someone else that is NOT revealed, 33% chance that you'll lose 1 morale on the next cycle change.

Telepath.Flavor Text: You can hear and project thoughts. This has myriad applications, but sometimes they won't shut up...
Telepath.Description: Enables radio/map access without a trackie. Immune to Mute and Deaf status. However, increases the chance and intensity of psychological disorders, and they are much harder to cure.
